actual_scope: An exact cross-rim Schur determinant for every bandwidth-b matrix with an invertible m-coordinate interior, m>=b; its Gaussian specialization and exact linear channel obstruction.
scope_change_reason: This is an original structural precision/tape boundary result, not an audit or discharge of a selected assumption. It adds an exact determinant beyond prior support/sign statements and applies over any field once the interior is invertible.
bottleneck_link: The retained Gaussian boundary solve allows O(b) width. Exact rank compression below b cannot replace this cross-rim map; approximation and its precision/cost contract remain open.
stop_rule: Stop at the first verified determinant formula and its exact channel consequence. Do not extend to approximate ranks, another interior geometry or a complete supplier.
